items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the Iron Phalanx game-card illustration, retaining its original landscape aspect ratio and composition. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the sole composition source. Image 2 is Heixiang's current character identity reference only; do not copy its coffee cup, saucer, sword, standing pose or white background. Images 3, 4 and 5 are DRAWING-STYLE references only: broad opaque brush construction, grouped dark fabric, and anime facial drawing respectively. Do not copy their characters or costume.

Preserve image 1's elevated camera, centered small full-body warrior with both arms firmly folded across his chest, forward stare and planted feet. Preserve the floating ring of small luminous cards immediately around his body, and the enclosing broad elliptical ring of tall pointed iron shields. The far shields are smaller and form an arc across the top of the image; the near shields are greatly enlarged across the lower foreground, overlap each other and obscure the warrior's lower legs. Keep this near/far scale relationship, ring opening, camera distance, positions and shield silhouettes. The shield ring must remain the dominant large enclosing shape, not a few handheld shields. Preserve the original blue-gray and muted violet overall palette, dark foreground shield band, paler far shield band and restrained cyan/mint card accents.

Bring only the warrior's identity into line with image 2: massive broad-shouldered adult male, deep tan/dark skin, thick black short hair slicked back exposing the forehead, amber gold eyes, confident smirk and stitched scar on his left cheek. Keep the original black combat suit, gloves, pants, single heavy shoulder plate and warm ochre/brown-orange neck scarf, with the exact original crossed-arm action. Do not add a weapon or cup. Give the small face economical readable anime marks; retain his commanding silhouette at the original scale.

Rough hand-painted anime color study. Large connected opaque color masses, a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, decisive handmade edges, grouped hard-edged shadows and selective unfinished areas. Coherent substantial hair locks and principal cloth planes, a few selective structural line accents and broad midtone turns. Adapt this same broad opaque stroke grammar to the iron shields: simple readable borders and a few structural marks, broad cool shadow and light planes; greatly reduce the original tiny engravings without losing shield shape or ring depth. Keep spacious quiet interiors and selective expressive overlaps. Matte muted colors with concentrated accents. No fine strands, dense wrinkles, tiny facets, glossy 3D, polished airbrush shading, or all-over grain and scratch filters.

Background remains an abstract dark blue-gray/violet field with broad subdued color transitions following the original, and the pale cool center behind the warrior. No constructed room, scenery, text, card lettering, frame, watermark or UI. One finished illustration.
